subject.title: boot-md hook re-runs BOOT.md on every gateway restart

question: Should boot-md remain a documented per-gateway-startup check, or should BOOT.md become a run-once per workspace/config-generation lifecycle with an explicit reset path?
rationale: Current docs and tests support recurring startup behavior, while the issue and production comment report real harm from repeated runs; choosing storage/reset semantics is product direction, not a safe automatic sentinel-file patch.

options.title: Define run-once lifecycle
options.body: Make BOOT.md run once per chosen workspace/config lifecycle, with canonical state, reset behavior, docs, and regression tests before implementation.

options.title: Preserve recurring startup checks
options.body: Keep current documented per-startup behavior and close or re-scope this issue to narrower performance/session bugs only.

options.title: Split the concepts
options.body: Keep boot-md as the recurring startup-check hook and create a separate first-run initialization surface if maintainers want both behaviors.

recommendation.title: Define run-once lifecycle
recommendation.body: Make BOOT.md run once per chosen workspace/config lifecycle, with canonical state, reset behavior, docs, and regression tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: ngutman introduced boot-md as a gateway-startup automation hook and is the clearest history owner for the original lifecycle intent.
